title: Indian Air Force Agniveer Vayu Full Length Mock Test 02 (Hard Level)
description: Hard Level Full Length Mock Test for IAF Agniveer Vayu (Science + Other than Science combined pattern). 100 Questions | 85 Minutes | English 20, Physics 25, Mathematics 25, Reasoning & General Awareness 30.
instructions: Yeh Hard Level Full Length Mock Test hai.
Total 100 questions: English 20, Physics 25, Mathematics 25, Reasoning & General Awareness 30.
Har question 1 mark ka hai. Galat jawab par 0.25 marks katenge.
Time: 85 minutes (official combined Science + Other than Science pattern).
Physics and Mathematics 10+2 CBSE level; English 10+2; RAGA includes Reasoning and GK/Defence.

questions.subject: English
questions.question: Identify the error: The squadron of fighters were flying in close formation.
questions.explanation: Squadron is a collective noun treated as singular here; use was flying.

questions.subject: English
questions.question: Antonym of TRANSIENT is:
questions.explanation: Transient means short-lived; opposite is permanent.

questions.subject: English
questions.question: To bite the bullet means:
options: To face a difficult situation bravely
questions.explanation: It means to endure a painful situation with courage.

questions.subject: English
questions.question: A person who designs aircraft is called:
questions.explanation: Aircraft design is the work of an aeronautical engineer.

questions.subject: English
questions.question: Change to passive: The pilot had already briefed the crew.
options: The crew had already been briefed by the pilot.
The crew was briefing the pilot.
The pilot was briefed by the crew.
questions.explanation: Past perfect active becomes had been + V3.

questions.subject: English
questions.question: She said, "I shall report at 0500 hours."
options: She said that she should report at 0500 hours.
She said that she would report at 0500 hours.
She said that I would report at 0500 hours.
She said she shall report at 0500 hours.
questions.explanation: Shall/will of first person becomes would in reported speech.

questions.subject: English
questions.question: The helicopter hovered ___ the landing pad.
questions.explanation: Hover above is the standard preposition.

questions.subject: English
questions.question: If the weather ___ , the sortie will be cancelled.
questions.explanation: First conditional: If + present, will + V1.

questions.subject: English
questions.question: Select the correct sentence.
options: None of the cadets was absent.
None of the cadet were absent.
None of the cadets were absents.
questions.explanation: None can take singular was; option 1 is grammatically clean.
